text: BAM's share of Solana stake eased to 37.7% (162.6M SOL) over the past 25 hours. Just 3 of the 17 live nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 21.9% and 94 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. The top node by stake changed hands 68 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
